name: Wo Buyao Yige Ren Shuijiao ya!
source:
A-Rang is unable to sleep alone, ever since the woman in red began appearing in his room.

Now, with help from four "companions", he draws closer to a horrifying truth.

[From [url=https://phoenix-dalo.itch.io/insomnia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从红衣女人出现在他的房间后，阿让就无法独自入睡。

现在，在四位“同伴”的帮助下，他越来越接近一个可怕的真相。

[来自[url=https://phoenix-dalo.itch.io/insomnia]Itch.io[/url]]
